triples.head_surface: failure of the lubricating oil system
triples.tail_surface: Automatic means of shutting off the steam supply
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 自动切断蒸汽供应装置
triples.evidence_text: Automatic means of shutting off the steam supply (including exhaust steam supply) through a quick acting device is also to be fitted for all steam turbines upon overspeed (see 4-2-4/7.1) and upon failure of the lubricating oil system (see 4-6-6/9).

triples.tail_surface: Automatic means of shutting off the steam supply
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 自动切断蒸汽供应装置
triples.evidence_text: Automatic means of shutting off the steam supply (including exhaust steam supply) through a quick acting device is also to be fitted for all steam turbines upon overspeed (see 4-2-4/7.1) and upon failure of the lubricating oil system (see 4-6-6/9).

Sentinel valves or equivalent are to be fitted to all main and auxiliary steam turbine exhausts to provide a warning of excessive pressure to personnel in the vicinity of the exhaust end of steam turbines.

triples.tail_surface: means are to be provided to prevent water entering the turbine
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 防止水进入汽轮机的措施
triples.evidence_text: If exhaust steam is admitted to a turbine, means are to be provided to prevent water entering the turbine.
